evidence_scope: 1993-2025 development labels on corrected Issue 61 folds and complete unlabeled product geometry

figure_captions.fig01_outer_rmse.png: Figure 1. Pooled corrected-fold point RMSE for the frozen SSS and fCO2 candidates. Geographic, whole-region, and forward partitions quantify transfer error rather than random-row interpolation.
figure_captions.fig02_outer_coverage90.png: Figure 2. Empirical 90% interval coverage on corrected outer folds. Cruise coverage is near nominal, while multiple shifted partitions fall below the frozen 0.85 lower bound.
figure_captions.fig03_outer_wis.png: Figure 3. Weighted interval score for the selected target-specific interval rules across all corrected validation schemes; lower values indicate sharper calibrated distributions.
figure_captions.fig04_sss_risk_coverage.png: Figure 4. SSS RMSE as observations are retained through fixed cruise-derived risk thresholds. Shifted regions retain fewer rows and remain harder even at matched risk cutoffs.
figure_captions.fig05_fco2_risk_coverage.png: Figure 5. fCO2 RMSE at fixed 50%, 75%, 90%, and complete cruise-derived risk envelopes. Risk ranking is useful in-distribution but weak under whole-region transfer.
figure_captions.fig06_ab_observed_rmse.png: Figure 6. RMSE among observations receiving frozen A/B status in each outer scheme. Geographic folds yield no A/B rows because the support envelope correctly abstains everywhere.
figure_captions.fig07_product_grade_area.png: Figure 7. Mean area-weighted A/B/C/D coverage across the complete 396-month by 838,661-node product geometry. Difficult areas remain present as C/D rather than being discarded.
figure_captions.fig08_trusted_area_by_year.png: Figure 8. Area-weighted A/B fraction from 1993 through 2025. Changes reflect predictor availability and distance from the temporal and environmental training envelope.
figure_captions.fig09_sss_grade_map_2025_07.png: Figure 9. Global coastal SSS applicability grades in July 2025. A/B is concentrated near demonstrated observational support; C is diagnostic and D is suppressed.
figure_captions.fig10_fco2_grade_map_2025_07.png: Figure 10. Global coastal fCO2 applicability grades in July 2025. The full geometry is retained, including unsupported coasts marked D rather than silently omitted.
figure_captions.fig11_reason_bit_prevalence.png: Figure 11. Area-weighted prevalence of each deployable reason bit in July 2025. Multiple bits may coexist, so fractions are diagnostic and do not sum to one.
figure_captions.fig12_regional_calibration.png: Figure 12. Cruise-fold 90% coverage in the fifteen observation regions with the largest row counts. Regional heterogeneity remains visible despite near-nominal pooled cruise coverage.
